text:
[LGRA.12.6.1] `30` alone: integer literal.
`30_s` and `30s`: the same duration literal — the
underscore separator is optional ([LUNI.3.1.1]).
`30 s` (whitespace): integer `30` followed by identifier
`s` — typically a compile error in context. Whitespace is
the one thing that breaks the literal; the separator's
presence does not.
